visual_enhancers: Subtle film grain/noise overlay across the entire page.
Clipped and arched frames for imagery to give an editorial, art-gallery feel.
Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or black/60 with 1px delicate inner border) for sticky header and cart bar.
Generous padding (p-12 to p-32) between major sections for a premium, uncrowded feel.
Solid, high-contrast borders for brutalist-inspired segments (like the QR code block).

components.hero: Large kinetic text 'Good Food. Good Mood.' with masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion. A large clipped rectangular hero image layered dynamically with the text. Subtle parallax effect on scroll.
components.marquee: Slow, organic editorial marquee (react-fast-marquee) showing 'The Cafeteria • Delivery Available • GC CRPF Doyapur • +91 9101328562'. Uses large serif outline typography.
components.menu_navigation: Sticky side navigation for categories on desktop, smooth horizontal scroll list on mobile.
components.menu_grid: Elegant, borderless card list or bento grid. Each food item gets a large spotlight image, bold typography, and a pill-shaped 'Add' button.
components.cart_sidebar: Slide-out or sticky bottom bar on mobile / sidebar on desktop. Displays subtotal only. Clear text stating 'Delivery & Packaging charges to be confirmed manually'.
components.qr_menu: A striking, bold editorial block featuring the QR code for digital access.
components.admin_panel: Clean, dense dashboard using Shadcn UI (Tables, Dialog, Forms) for managing items, prices, and availability. Simple password login.

layouts.main: Mobile-first. Asymmetrical bento grid for storytelling sections; strict, structured hierarchy for the menu.
layouts.menu: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-12 (Categories sticky in col-span-3, Items scrolling in col-span-9).

motion.scroll: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site a heavy, premium feel.
motion.sections: Staggered fade-up and slide-up on scroll.
motion.micro: Hover states on menu items (image slight scale/zoom, or button background fill).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratio. Text on images must have gradient overlay.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

dumplings_momos.description: Menu category or item image for Momos/Dumplings

milkshake_drinks.description: Menu category or item image for Shakes/Drinks

cafe_vendor.description: Story/Vibe image for 'Our Vibe' or Manifesto section

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Framer Motion for the kinetic line-by-line masked text reveal in the hero.
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
Build the menu using the provided HTML data as the source of truth.
Shopping Cart must not auto-calculate delivery. Show subtotal and a static message 'Delivery & Packaging charges to be confirmed manually'.
Use Shadcn UI for the Admin Panel but heavily customize HTML/Tailwind for the landing page to achieve the Awwwards-level design.
WhatsApp checkout: On checkout, save the order to the backend DB, then open a wa.me link with a pre-filled message to +91 9101328562.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Never use `transition: all`. Apply specific transitions to avoid breaking transforms.
Use pill-shaped or sharp modern buttons with interaction animations.
No emoji icons. Use Lucide React or similar professional icon library.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
